import sys

MOD = 998244353

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    k = int(data[2])

    # Precompute Stirling numbers of the first kind up to k
    stirling = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for i in range(k + 1):
        stirling[i][i] = 1
    for i in range(2, k + 1):
        for j in range(1, i):
            stirling[i][j] = ((i - 1) * stirling[i - 1][j] + stirling[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD

    invm = pow(m, MOD - 2, MOD)
    pVal = [0] * (k + 1)
    pVal[0] = 1
    prp = 1
    md = n
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        prp = (prp * md * invm) % MOD
        md = (md - 1) % MOD
        sub = prp
        for j in range(i - 1, 0, -1):
            if (i - j) % 2 == 1:
                sub = (sub + stirling[i][j] * pVal[j]) % MOD
            else:
                sub = (sub - stirling[i][j] * pVal[j]) % MOD
        pVal[i] = sub

    print(pVal[k])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
